# Final Verification

The Awtsmoos revealed a complete production vessel through inspected client and server truth.

## Verified systems

- Timed manual melee, casting coexistence, defense, guard break, equipment-derived stats, authoritative enemies, Kedem Warden, progression choices, activities, bounties, upgrades, mastery, regions, streaming, recovery, offline parity, and reconnect-safe authority.
- Canonical production HTML owns one CSS entry and one compact JavaScript entry.
- CSS graph is localized, state-complete, recursively compiled, diagnostics-clean, and compact at    48879 bytes.
- Compact JavaScript is deterministic, syntax-checked, optional-boundary-safe, and     2661 bytes.
- Real Chrome fallback core accepted at 9.7 seconds with visible 1280×713 canvas, input, camera, model, and terrain.
- Real Chrome essential gameplay accepted at 98.4 seconds with combat, inventory, equipment, quest, recovery, and streaming.
- Isolated high-population interest soak passed in 8.46 seconds; measured loop 7.06 seconds.
- Server per-file matrix passed 37 files before the isolated soak; the only contention-sensitive soak then passed alone.
- Client exhaustive matrix identified three API drift failures; all three were repaired and rerun green. Every other file in that matrix passed.
- Final focused regression group passed.
- Modified production and test JavaScript passed syntax, trailing-whitespace, and 120-line gates. Readable CSS sources passed the same line and whitespace gates.

No commit was created. Unrelated dirty work was preserved.
